evidence.note: TRAAC is an online GRPO-based RL method that prunes a reasoning model's chain-of-thought using attention scores from the </think> token and calibrates how aggressively it prunes based on estimated problem difficulty, so it thinks less on easy problems and more on hard ones.
evidence.title: Think Right: Learning to Mitigate Under-Over Thinking via Adaptive, Attentive Compression

name: difficulty-adaptive compression rate calibrated by rollout pass rate
